# sherpa-loader

An animated loading indicator. CSS-only off data-* on the host.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Loading Spinner (atom) |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-loader/sherpa-loader.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-loader/sherpa-loader.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-loader/sherpa-loader.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-loader/sherpa-loader.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-loader/sherpa-loader.example.json) |

## When to use it

To say "please wait" while something loads; it spins, and a screen reader hears it as a status. For a card that loads, set `data-loading` on its `sherpa-container`, which shows a loader itself; for work you can measure, use `sherpa-progress-bar`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-loader data-size="sm"><span slot="label">Loading customers…</span></sherpa-loader>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-orientation` | `horizontal` `vertical` | `horizontal` | horizontal \| vertical |
| `data-panel` | boolean | `false` | render a solid surface background behind the loader |
| `data-size` | `sm` `md` `lg` | `md` | sm \| md \| lg (spinner diameter; default md) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | loading text shown beside (or below) the spinner |

## CSS custom properties it reads

What each class's base rule reads:

| Custom property | Class | Property |
|---|---|---|
| `--sherpa-theme-content-line-height-base` | `.label` | `line-height` |
| `--sherpa-display-mode-border-rounding-full` | `.spinner` | `border-radius` |
| `--sherpa-theme-surface-default-2` | `.spinner` | `border-width` |

## populate()

`{ orientation?, panel?, size? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
